title: Layer
desc: A logical container controlling visibility, color, line type, and plotting behavior.
extra: Start with layers to keep drawings readable and editable.

title: Block
desc: Reusable grouped geometry, often used for symbols and repeated components.
extra: Blocks reduce repetitive drafting work and improve consistency.

title: Xref
desc: External reference file linked into a drawing for collaboration across teams.
extra: Critical in AEC multi‑discipline projects.

title: Constraint
desc: Rules in sketch/model that lock geometry relationships and design intent.
extra: Key to parametric modeling behavior.

title: Tolerance
desc: Allowed dimensional variation for manufacturing and assembly acceptance.
extra: Fundamental term for mechanical production quality.

title: BIM
desc: Building Information Modeling: data‑rich model approach for AEC lifecycle workflows.
extra: Not only geometry, also metadata and coordination.

title: DWG compatibility mode
desc: How a CAD platform reads/writes Autodesk‑style DWGs—fonts, substitutes, proxies, scale lists.
extra: Consult your exact build’s migration chapter; never assume bit‑for‑bit identity across vendors.

title: Command alias (PGP)
desc: Keyboard shortcuts to commands—the muscle memory bridge when moving between DWG editors.
extra: Aliases differ by platform; keep a personal table when you multi‑boot Linux/Windows.

title: Mechanical BOM
desc: Bill of materials generated from parts lists in mechanical verticals—ties annotations to rows and quantity fields.
extra: Validate against your PDM/ERP export template before production cutover.

title: Point cloud (scan)
desc: Dense 3D measurement points from LiDAR/photogrammetry used for as‑builts and clash context.
extra: Registration, noise, and density drive whether you trace linework or model directly.

title: AEC object style
desc: Wall/slab/stair styles in architectural verticals—parameters drive plan/elevation behavior like a lightweight BIM‑lite.
extra: Export expectations to plain DWG may flatten smart objects—plan your deliverable early.

title: SYSVAR
desc: System variables controlling snaps, file paths, user preferences—think global toggles with saved profiles.
extra: Back up a known‑good profile before experimenting in production projects.

title: PDF underlay
desc: Attach a PDF page behind vector geometry for tracing or redlines without converting every entity.
extra: Watch scale and layer contrast; heavy PDFs can slow pan/zoom.

title: GRX / .NET API
desc: Vendor APIs to automate commands, build add‑ins, or integrate data—differs from simple script macros.
extra: Match API level to your build; sign binaries per enterprise policy.

title: DWG FastView markup
desc: Lightweight review layer for redlines and measures in viewer clients—separate from full DWG editing.
extra: Clarify whether markups round‑trip to desktop CAD or stay as overlays.

title: Large‑assembly view
desc: Navigation modes for heavy 3D models—levels of detail, selection filters, clipping.
extra: Tune hardware vs software rendering; viewer apps often trade precision for FPS.

title: IFC interchange
desc: Open BIM schema for exchanging building models among tools—LOD, MVD drive what travels cleanly.
extra: Coordinate with partners on authoring vs coordination exports.

title: DWG Compare
desc: A core 2026 feature that identifies differences between two versions of a drawing with color‑coded overlays.
extra: In GstarCAD 2026, comparison logic is optimized for faster diffing of complex Xrefs.

title: Parametric Constraints
desc: Rules that define geometry relationships (Parallel, Tangent) and dimensions (Distance, Radius) linked to variables.
extra: GstarCAD 2026 Phase 2 introduces the Parameters Manager for formula‑driven design.

title: Dynamic Input
desc: Provides a command interface near the cursor to help keep focus on the drafting area.
extra: Press F12 to toggle on and off.

title: Annotative Scaling
desc: Automatically sizes text, dimensions, and blocks based on viewport scale.
extra: Eliminates the need for multiple text layers.

title: Sheet Set Manager
desc: Organizes, displays, and manages sheet layouts across multiple drawing files.
extra: Crucial for large project coordination.

title: Paper Space
desc: The layout environment used for creating title blocks and plot sheets.
extra: Contrasts with Model Space where 1:1 drawing occurs.

title: Object Snap (OSNAP)
desc: Forces the cursor to snap to exact points like endpoints, midpoints, and centers.
extra: Essential for drafting precision.

title: Hatch
desc: Fills an enclosed area or selected objects with a pattern, solid fill, or gradient.
extra: Often used to represent materials in sections.

title: Polyline
desc: A connected sequence of line and arc segments treated as a single object.
extra: Can have width and thickness assigned.

title: AutoLISP
desc: A programming language used inside AutoCAD to automate repetitive commands.
extra: Not supported in AutoCAD LT.

title: Viewport
desc: A 'window' on a layout sheet that looks into model space at a specific scale.
extra: Can be polygonal or locked to prevent accidental zoom.

title: External Reference (XREF)
desc: A master drawing that links in other DWG files without embedding them.
extra: Keeps file sizes low and enables team drafting.

title: Revit Family
desc: A parametric component library file (.rfa) that can be loaded into a project.
extra: Includes system, loadable, and in-place families.

title: Worksharing
desc: Allows multiple team members to work on the same Revit project simultaneously.
extra: Relies on a Central Model and Local Copies.

title: Workset
desc: A collection of elements in a workshared project, typically divided by system or floor.
extra: Used to control visibility and check-out rights.

title: View Template
desc: A collection of view properties (scale, discipline, overrides) to enforce standards.
extra: Applying it locks the properties for consistency.

title: Shared Parameter
desc: A definition stored in an external text file so schedules and tags can read the data across projects.
extra: Critical for cross-family data aggregation.

title: Level
desc: An infinite horizontal plane that acts as a reference for floor, roof, and ceiling hosts.
extra: Usually represents finished floor elevations.

title: Phasing
desc: Tracks the lifecycle of elements across time (Existing, Demolished, New Construction).
extra: Automatically generates proper graphical overrides.

title: Schedule
desc: A tabular display of information extracted directly from the properties of project elements.
extra: Updating the schedule updates the 3D model bidirectionally.

title: System Family
desc: Families built into the Revit template (walls, roofs, floors) that cannot be saved externally.
extra: You duplicate types to create variations.

title: Design Options
desc: Allows exploring multiple alternative designs within a single project file.
extra: Keeps the main model clean while alternatives are reviewed.

title: IPT (Part)
desc: The foundational 3D modeling file format in Inventor for single components.
extra: Can represent solid bodies or sheet metal parts.

title: IAM (Assembly)
desc: A file that constraints multiple IPT parts together to simulate real-world mechanisms.
extra: Contains BOM and motion data.

title: IPN (Presentation)
desc: Used to create exploded views, animations, and assembly instructions.
extra: Feeds directly into 2D drawing views.

title: iLogic
desc: An integrated VB.NET environment to automate rules and drive parametric configurations.
extra: Accessible to non-programmers via snippet insertion.

title: Content Center
desc: A database of millions of standard components (fasteners, steel profiles).
extra: Connects with Vault to manage standard libraries.

title: Model States
desc: Allows multiple representations of a part or assembly in one file (e.g., machined vs cast).
extra: Replaces legacy Levels of Detail (LODs).

title: Frame Generator
desc: Automates the creation of structural steel frames along sketch wireframes.
extra: Handles miters, notches, and end caps automatically.

title: AnyCAD
desc: Technology allowing Inventor to link third-party CAD files without translation.
extra: Retains associativity if the native file updates.

title: Sheet Metal Rules
desc: Global definitions controlling material thickness, bend radius, and relief shape.
extra: Drives flat pattern generation accuracy.

title: Shrinkwrap
desc: Creates a simplified outer shell of a complex assembly to protect IP and save memory.
extra: Useful for sharing models with external vendors.

title: Body vs Component
desc: A body is a single solid; a component is a container holding bodies, sketches, and origins.
extra: Always create components to enable joint motion.

title: Parametric Timeline
desc: Records design history at the bottom of the screen; can be rewound to edit past features.
extra: Forms the basis of parametric modeling in Fusion.

title: Joint
desc: Defines motion degrees of freedom between components (e.g., slider, revolute, rigid).
extra: Replaces traditional multi-step mating constraints.

title: T-Splines
desc: The technology powering the Form workspace for sub-divisional, organic surface modeling.
extra: Great for ergonomic industrial design.

title: Generative Design
desc: Uses cloud computing and AI to synthesize hundreds of structural design options.
extra: Optimized for weight, strength, and manufacturing method.

title: CAM Setup
desc: Defines stock size, origin point, and machine type in the Manufacturing workspace.
extra: The prerequisite for generating toolpaths.

title: Cloud Rendering
desc: Offloads complex ray-tracing calculations to Autodesk's servers, freeing local hardware.
extra: Consumes cloud credits based on quality.

title: Direct Modeling
desc: A history-free mode allowing push/pull changes to geometry without a timeline.
extra: Perfect for modifying imported, dumb solids.

title: Mesh Workspace
desc: Tools to repair, remesh, and convert STL/OBJ faceted files into usable solid bodies.
extra: Essential for reverse engineering 3D scans.

title: Fusion Team Hub
desc: The cloud storage environment where projects, files, and role-based permissions reside.
extra: Enables cross-organization collaboration.

title: TIN Surface
desc: A Triangulated Irregular Network representing topographical ground data.
extra: Can represent existing ground (EG) or finished ground (FG).

title: Alignment
desc: A 2D geometric path defining the horizontal routing of a road, pipe, or channel.
extra: Stationing is generated along this baseline.

title: Profile
desc: Represents the vertical elevation changes along an Alignment path.
extra: Displayed in a Profile View grid.

title: Assembly
desc: The cross-section template of a corridor, built from individual subassemblies like lanes and curbs.
extra: Acts as the 'extrusion profile' for roads.

title: Corridor
desc: The complex 3D model generated by combining an Alignment, Profile, and Assembly.
extra: Produces material volume calculations.

title: Feature Line
desc: A smart 3D line storing varied elevations at vertices, heavily used in site grading.
extra: Can interact to create dynamic surfaces.

title: Grading Group
desc: A collection of grading objects (like pond slopes) that interact to generate a unified surface.
extra: Automatically balances cut and fill.

title: Pipe Network
desc: Intelligent objects representing gravity or pressure piping systems with structures.
extra: Includes clash detection against other utilities.

title: Data Shortcuts
desc: XML links allowing civil objects (surfaces, alignments) to be referenced across multiple DWGs.
extra: Replaces Xrefs for intelligent civil data.

title: Parcel
desc: An enclosed polygon representing property boundaries, automatically tracking area and perimeter.
extra: Labels update dynamically if boundaries shift.

title: NWC (Cache)
desc: A lightweight exported file from native authoring tools (like Revit or AutoCAD).
extra: Loads significantly faster than native geometry.

title: NWF (File Set)
desc: The working federated master file linking multiple NWC files together without embedding them.
extra: Holds clashes, viewpoints, and markups.

title: NWD (Document)
desc: A baked, single-file snapshot containing all geometry and markups, heavily compressed.
extra: Used to share frozen project states with clients.

title: Clash Detective
desc: Module to find interferences between structural, architectural, and MEP disciplines.
extra: Only available in Navisworks Manage.

title: TimeLiner
desc: Connects 3D model elements to project schedules to visualize construction sequencing.
extra: Often called 4D BIM.

title: Quantification
desc: Extracts highly accurate bill of materials, areas, and volumes mapped to cost codes.
extra: Often called 5D BIM.

title: Search Set
desc: A dynamic grouping of elements based on property logic (e.g., 'Category = Duct').
extra: Updates automatically if new elements match.

title: Selection Set
desc: A static grouping of manually picked items, saved for quick isolation or coloring.
extra: Does not update if the model changes.

title: Viewpoint
desc: A saved camera view retaining section boxes, hiding overrides, and redlines.
extra: Crucial for generating clash reports.

title: SwitchBack
desc: A tool that syncs the Navisworks camera view directly back to the native Revit/CAD application.
extra: Speeds up error correction.

title: FeatureManager
desc: The design tree on the left of the screen listing chronological modeling steps.
extra: Equivalent to the browser in other CAD systems.

title: Configuration
desc: Creates multiple variations of a part within a single document.
extra: Driven by a Design Table.

title: SmartMates
desc: Automatically applies mating constraints by holding 'Alt' and dragging faces together.
extra: Dramatically speeds up assembly.

title: Pack and Go
desc: Gathers all related files for a model design into a folder or zip file.
extra: Prevents missing references when sharing.

title: Weldments
desc: A multi-body part environment for designing frames from standard structural profiles.
extra: Automatically generates cut lists.

title: Mate Reference
desc: Pre-defines mating rules on a part so it snaps instantly when dropped into assemblies.
extra: Great for standard hardware.

title: SpeedPak
desc: Creates a simplified configuration of an assembly without losing references.
extra: Increases performance on large assemblies.

title: Evaluate Tab
desc: Contains tools for mass properties, measuring, interference detection, and draft analysis.
extra: The diagnostic hub of the interface.

title: SOLIDWORKS PDM
desc: Product Data Management software managing file versions and check-in/out workflows.
extra: Integrates directly into Windows Explorer.

title: SLDDRW
desc: The 2D drawing file format dynamically linked to the 3D part or assembly.
extra: Updates automatically if the 3D model changes.

title: GSD (Generative Shape Design)
desc: The premier workbench for complex surface modeling and wireframe skeletons.
extra: Industry standard in automotive Class-A surfacing.

title: PartBody
desc: The primary container within a CATPart holding solid mechanical features.
extra: Can interact with surfaces via boolean operations.

title: Geometrical Set
desc: A container for wireframes and surfaces, organized independently from the solid history tree.
extra: Keeps construction elements organized.

title: PowerCopy
desc: A smart template capturing geometry and design intent that can be rapidly instantiated.
extra: Adapts to new target surfaces.

title: Publication
desc: A method to publish important geometry (planes, sketches) to safely link between external files.
extra: Prevents broken links when replacing parts.

title: DMU (Digital Mock-Up)
desc: Workbenches dedicated to reviewing massive assemblies, kinematics, and space analysis.
extra: Handles gigabytes of visualization data.

title: Knowledge Advisor
desc: Embeds engineering rules, checks, and formulas directly into the design.
extra: Turns geometry into smart, constraint-driven models.

title: CGR File
desc: CATIA Graphical Representation; a lightweight faceted format for visualization only.
extra: Cannot be edited or measured precisely.

title: CAA (Component Application Architecture)
desc: The C++ API framework for developing deep, custom workbenches in CATIA.
extra: Used by aerospace firms for proprietary tools.

title: Boolean Operations
desc: Combining multiple PartBodies using Add, Remove, or Intersect logic.
extra: Essential for complex mold and die design.

title: Pro/ENGINEER
desc: The legacy brand name of Creo, pioneering the parametric, feature-based modeling paradigm.
extra: Renamed to Creo in 2010.

title: Creo Direct
desc: A standalone app or mode for history-free, direct modeling interactions.
extra: Ideal for late-stage design changes.

title: Family Table
desc: A spreadsheet driving multiple instances of a part (e.g., varying lengths of a screw).
extra: Similar to configurations in other tools.

title: Windchill
desc: PTC's enterprise PLM software tightly integrated with Creo for data management.
extra: Manages workflows, BOMs, and CAD versions.

title: Unite Technology
desc: Allows Creo to directly open non-native CAD formats without translation errors.
extra: Preserves design intent from CATIA, NX, etc.

title: Mapkey
desc: A recorded keyboard macro that automates repetitive GUI clicks in Creo.
extra: Massively improves user drafting speed.

title: Skeleton Model
desc: A special part used in Top-Down design to distribute spatial claims to sub-components.
extra: Does not appear in the final BOM.

title: FMX (Flexible Modeling)
desc: Allows geometry editing directly on the model while retaining parametric intelligence.
extra: Blends direct and parametric paradigms.

title: Mechanism Dynamics
desc: Evaluates the kinematic and dynamic performance of moving assemblies.
extra: Includes motors, springs, and gravity simulations.

title: ModelCHECK
desc: An automated tool that evaluates CAD models against corporate modeling standards.
extra: Prevents bad geometry from entering the vault.

title: Standard Parts Library
desc: A massive built-in library of screws, nuts, and pins that conform to global standards.
extra: Automatically sizes based on hole selections.

title: Automatic BOM
desc: Scans balloons and parts references to generate an associative bill of materials table.
extra: Updates immediately if balloons are deleted.

title: Intelligent Dimension
desc: A single dimensioning tool that adapts to lines, arcs, or angles depending on cursor position.
extra: Replaces multiple distinct dimension commands.

title: Hole Chart
desc: Automatically detects hole diameters and locations, generating a coordinate table.
extra: Crucial for CNC drilling preparation.

title: Hidden Line Evaluation
desc: Automatically calculates foreground/background overlaps in 2D to dash hidden edges.
extra: Saves hours of manual layer adjustments.

title: Title Block Automation
desc: Title blocks dynamically link to project properties and automatically scale to the layout.
extra: Ensures ISO/ANSI compliance.

title: Power Erase
desc: Deleting a mechanical feature automatically heals the surrounding geometry.
extra: Example: Erasing a screw hole restores the solid plate line.

title: Detail View Generator
desc: Draw a circle around an area to instantly generate a scaled, associative detail callout.
extra: Updates if the source geometry changes.

title: Surface Texture Symbol
desc: Pre-configured symbols for machining finishes adhering to international standards.
extra: Attaches parametrically to target lines.

title: Welding Symbol
desc: A dialogue-driven tool to generate complex welding instructions on the drawing.
extra: Supports all weld types and staggers.

title: My Cloud
desc: The integrated storage allowing automatic file synchronization across mobile and PC.
extra: Provides a seamless transition from office to site.

title: Offline Mode
desc: Allows caching of heavy DWGs to local device storage for construction site review.
extra: No internet required to view or markup.

title: Inquiry Tools
desc: Snap-based tools to accurately measure distance, area, and coordinates without editing.
extra: Ensures site dimensions match plans.

title: Markup
desc: Add clouds, text notes, and voice memos to drawings for rapid communication.
extra: Syncs back to the office instantly.

title: Font Manager
desc: Handles missing SHX fonts by allowing users to map substitutions or upload missing files.
extra: Prevents garbled text on mobile displays.

title: Layer Control
desc: Toggle visibility, freeze, and lock layers directly from the mobile interface.
extra: Helps isolate specific disciplines like MEP.

title: Layout Switching
desc: Navigate between Model space and multiple Paper Space layouts effortlessly.
extra: Retains viewport scaling settings.

title: Export to PDF
desc: Convert a DWG view into a high-quality PDF directly from the mobile app.
extra: Great for emailing clients.

title: Extract Text
desc: Scans the drawing to pull all text entities into an exportable list or table.
extra: Useful for verifying bill of materials.

title: Version Compare
desc: Overlays two iterations of a drawing, highlighting additions in green and deletions in red.
extra: Crucial for change order verification.
